reviewText: Absolutely hooked on these bite-sized dramas! Perfect for my metro commute, and the vertical interface is super smooth.
One of the best game that I have ever find
Content quality is top notch. Really enjoying the thrillers, but wish they added more episodes to the ongoing series faster.
Bohot sahi app hai for quick entertainment. Loading speed is fast, even on my older Vivo phone. Thoda aur variety in comedy genres would be great.
The storytelling is quite addictive and the cliffhangers are insane! I watch a few episodes every night before bed.
App works fine mostly, but sometimes it takes a while to load offline downloads. Good concept though, especially the regional language support.
